title: Tennis Star Andy Murray Joins Jack Draper's Team as a Coach!
summary: Have you ever wished your big brother could help you with something really hard? For British tennis player Jack Draper, that wish just came true! Andy Murray, one of the greatest tennis players ever, is joining Draper's coaching team for the grass-court season. That includes Wimbledon, the most famous tennis tournament in the world, which starts on June 29. Murray knows a thing or two about winning. He's won three Grand Slam titles and used to be the world number one. Last year, he even coached Novak Djokovic for six months! Now, he's teaming up with Draper, who's 24 and has had a tough time with injuries. Draper hurt his knee and had to skip the French Open, but he's hoping to come back strong on grass. The two have been friends for a long time. Draper says Murray is like a 'big brother' to him. They've played on the same Davis Cup team for Great Britain, and there's a funny video of Draper singing and drinking beer on the bus with Murray after a big win. Draper's old coach, Jamie Delgado, left recently, so Murray stepping in feels like a perfect fit. It's like a master teaching an apprentice. With Murray's help, Draper might just have his best grass season yet. Who knows? Maybe we'll see some brotherly high-fives at Wimbledon!
why_it_matters: This shows how even top athletes need help from experienced friends, just like kids might ask an older sibling for advice in school or sports.

background_read: Andy Murray is one of Britain's most successful tennis players, having won Wimbledon twice and reaching world number one.
After retiring from playing, he took up coaching, including a brief job with Novak Djokovic.
Jack Draper is a younger British player who has shown promise but faced several injuries.
The grass-court season is a short period of tournaments before Wimbledon, where players adjust to the slick grass surface.
Article_Structure: WHO: Andy Murray and Jack Draper, British tennis players.
WHAT: Murray is joining Draper's coaching team for the grass-court season.
WHERE: Primarily at Wimbledon and other grass-court tournaments.
WHY: To help Draper overcome injuries and improve his game with Murray's champion experience.

perspectives.description: Draper gets a mentor who has won big titles, boosting his confidence and skills for the big tournaments.
